an4.1:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vajjīsu viharati Bhaṇḍagāme.
an4.1:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an4.1:2.1: Catunnaṃ bhikkhave dhammānaṃ ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evam idaṃ dīgham addhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañ c' eva tumhākañ ca.
an4.1:2.3: Ariyassa bhikkhave sīlassa ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evam idaṃ dīgham addhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañ c' eva tumhākañ ca.
an4.1:2.4: Ariyassa bhikkhave samādhissa ananubodhā appaṭivedhā . . . pe . . .
an4.1:2.5: Ariyāya bhikkhave paññāya ananubodhā appaṭivedhā . . . pe . . .
an4.1:2.6: Ariyāya bhikkhave vimuttiyā ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evam idaṃ dīgham addhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañ c' eva tumhākañ ca. 4.
an4.1:2.7: Tayidaṃ bhikkhave ariyaṃ sīlaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ, ariyo samādhi anubuddho paṭividdho, ariyā paññā anubuddhā paṭividdhā, ariyā vimutti anubuddhā paṭividdhā, ucchinnā bhavataṇhā khīṇā bhavanetti, n' atthi dāni punabbhavo ti. 5.
an4.1:3.2: idaṃ vatvā Sugato athāparaṃ etad avoca satthā'
